notes: Scan 113 continues the argument about known composites (158), then distinguishes the maps D_{d,delta} to D_delta as target maps and those to D_d as source maps. D_{d,delta} is described as the multiplicity of arrows between germs of submultiplicities associated with D. This reports the manuscript language, including its singular/plural mismatch, rather than correcting it.

Formula (165) identifies a fiber product over the common D_{d prime} with the triple-index object. Diagram (166) draws the associated projections. The manuscript draws the lower-left connection without a head while giving heads to the five other connections. This omitted head has been preserved even though the surrounding argument calls the connections morphisms.

The paragraph says that the previous description does not directly give the projection (167) that omits the intermediate d-prime level, then points to the endpoint product map (168). No independent proof of the existence or representability of these objects was supplied on this page.

The two resolved short arrows in (164)/(168) have small solid tips, unlike the bare lower-left diagram shaft. The body source relation has an even less developed terminal and remains explicitly arrow/dash doubtful. The top D_J relation has a visible short lower wing and is accepted as headed.

The parenthetical où has a visible accent. The singular sous-multiplicité, plural associés, absent la, unpointed isom, and literal terminal comma followed by two dots are retained without grammatical or typographical normalization.
The comma after canceled D_{d prime} survives below/right of the strike. The last display has no terminal full stop. Both details were checked on crops.
